title: Memorise and still generalise
caption: One training draw of the 20-D random-feature track (n = 100, σ = 0.3). Left: predictions on the training points vs their noisy labels. Middle and right: predictions on 2,000 test points against their projection on the signal direction, with the true function. The p = 2000 model reproduces every training label exactly and its test predictions hug the truth more tightly.
